personality_one_liner: A premium, highly functional workspace that blends clean iOS utility with refined gold accents to reflect a modern jewelry enterprise.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. 16px (lg) screen padding by default, 24px (xl) for tablet root padding. Ensure buttons have minimum 44px height.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling inventory lists.
Use on floating cart summary bar at the bottom of the screen (mobile).
Pair with >=70% surface/surfaceSecondary tint underneath to ensure absolute readability.
dont's: Do not use on data rows, product cards, or form inputs.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure role-based entry point using Username and PIN pad.

states.error: Inline red text above PIN pad.

screens.layout: Centered layout. On tablet, a clean white surfaceSecondary card in the center of a surface background. Standard 10-digit numeric pad for PIN entry below username input.

screens.name: Karyawan POS (Sales)
screens.purpose: Fast-paced sales interface to view stock, add to cart, and print receipts.

states.empty: Illustration of empty shelf with 'Belum ada barang di inventaris'.
states.error: Toast with retry button for sync failure.

screens.layout: Responsive Split. Mobile: 2-column product grid with a sticky floating cart summary button at the bottom. Tablet: Left 70% is a 3/4-col product grid, Right 30% is a persistent fixed Cart and Receipt panel.

screens.name: Warehouse Dashboard
screens.purpose: Inventory management, QR generation, and stock opname workflows.

states.error: Inline error strip below sticky header.

screens.layout: List-heavy utility layout. Use single-column list items with thumbnail, SKU, and Stock level. A primary FAB (Floating Action Button) fixed at bottom right for 'Scan QR / Input Stock'.

screens.name: Accounting Dashboard
screens.purpose: Financial daily recap and transaction logs.
screens.layout: Top section: 2 large summary cards (Total Income, Total Transactions) using Space Grotesk for metrics. Bottom section: Flat list of daily transactions sorted chronologically.

screens.name: Owner Command Center
screens.purpose: Master dashboard for profit tracking, price approvals, and employee management.
screens.layout: Dashboard grid. Highlight 'Laba Kotor', 'Laba Bersih', and 'Margin' in premium gold-tinted (brandTertiary) summary cards. Below, an 'Action Needed' section for Karyawan price approvals, followed by Employee list.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure layout strictly uses responsive styling to accommodate both Mobile and Tablet. On Tablet, the POS screen must use a Side-by-Side split view for Product Grid and Cart. Do NOT use single column for tablet.
Do not use pure black for text; use the defined charcoal (#1A1A1A) 'onSurface' to maintain the premium feel.
Banned hues: NO Blues, Indigos, or Purples anywhere in the app. Adhere purely to the White/Off-White and Gold palette.
Use Space Grotesk strictly for data numbers (prices, totals, percentages, calculator inputs) and Plus Jakarta Sans for all UI labels, body text, and headers.
Ensure 'brandTertiary' (#F9F3D9) is used as a soft background for icon containers or highlight rows to gently push the gold theme without being overwhelming.
When integrating the Camera for barcode scanning, ensure the view overlays a viewfinder box and features a 'Cancel' close button with clear safe-area padding.
For Karyawan POS grid items, use the provided `jewelry_sample_1` and `jewelry_sample_2` as dummy images. Maintain a 1:1 aspect ratio for product thumbnails with a subtle border (#E5E5EA).
